dse_runs.notes: Spec: 16-axis motor control, 32 simultaneous requests per 1us tick, all 32 results back within 0.44us p99. Max abs err <= 2^-12. Minimize LUTs+FFs. Throughput >= 32 Msps. Consider pipelined families for throughput; iterative may not meet 32 Msps.

final_text: Campaign complete. For the single spec **multiaxis_control**, I ran the full 400-evaluation L1 DSE graph (21-design feasible Pareto front, all pipelined_m family), then L2 SimPy system simulation of the top 5 — all passed the 0.44 µs p99 batch constraint (best simulated 0.395 µs). L3/L4 had no recorded verification or synthesis data for this configuration, and L5 back-annotation found no measured data to compare, so no winner change was flagged and no reexplore was needed. Finalized selection: **pipelined_m, data_width=17, n_iter=14, angle_guard=2, m=4** — 1090 LUTs+FFs (estimate), 93.6 Msps throughput, max error 2^-12.33 (exact, within the 2^-12 spec), simulated sys_p99_batch_us 0.395.
